summary: Production stewardship resumed from the stable V13 four-phone LAN qualification checkpoint; its 24-event source segment rehashed to de2b133151a7c4e14add2a8023b4fd2eafef2cca9974ded44ead0e529a5e9925.

An independent Node HTTP probe reached the live runtime through the host Wi-Fi interface and confirmed the managed bind policy; this is host-interface evidence, not firewall/router/phone proof.

The comparator remains honestly UNKNOWN with zero missing capabilities; transport.managed-lan-bind is available while qa.physical-four-phone-lan remains unknown.

Next native evidence remains an externally observed full 30-minute run on the intended router with four real phones, followed by representative target-hardware performance, human listening and attachment, deeper content after hardware confirmation, and explicit steward approval.

The persistent stewardship request authorizes updated active operational memory; this segment preserves decisive events without private reasoning, raw device identifiers, repetitive telemetry, or deletion of canonical/user material.
